mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate earnings and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, robust housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, strong housing starts (HOUST > 1600) are followed by negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity and corporate capacity utilization, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth above 0.5% is followed by negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing starts (HOUST < 1500) signal deteriorating consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1500, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of labor market slack (high unemployment), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In labor market slack regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 2.5% signals rising inflationary pressure that triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.
